summary: The current codebase still has several high‑ and medium‑severity issues from the previous review. All dependency vulnerabilities that are fixable (uuid) have been addressed, and the CSV‑injection and PDF‑HTML‑injection findings have been mitigated in code. However, high‑severity transitive dependencies (braces, node‑forge) remain vulnerable, and many medium‑severity code‑level concerns (numeric validation, backup passphrase policy, web key storage, temporary backup file cleanup, image size limits, key persistence after data‑wipe) are still open. No new critical issues were discovered, but the remaining high‑severity findings block release until resolved.
